title: Overseas landlord: pay a deposit before viewing
hook: A landlord who is abroad offers a flat at a low rent and says many people want it, so a holding deposit must be paid before any viewing.

opening_line.voice: Hello, I am calling about the flat you asked about. The rent is AED 3,500 a month, but I am abroad for work and several people want it.
opening_line.whatsapp: Hello, I saw you asked about my flat. The rent is AED 3,500 a month, but I am abroad for work and many people are interested.
opening_line.email: Thank you for your interest in my flat. I am currently working abroad, so I am reserving it for the first person who pays a holding deposit of AED 5,000.
opening_line.sms: Hi, the flat is still available at AED 3,500 a month. I have three other people asking, so let me know quickly if you want it.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Present yourself as the owner of a well-priced flat who is working abroad and cannot show it in person
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Say several other people want the flat and it goes to whoever pays the holding deposit first, today
stage_goals.ASK: Say the deposit secures the flat and the keys will be sent after, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Are you ready to transfer the holding deposit today so I can reserve the flat for you?
commit_signals: how do i pay the deposit
i will send the money now
red_flags: The landlord is abroad and cannot show the flat

lesson.headline: Never pay for a flat you have not seen
three_points: Do not send any deposit until you have viewed the flat in person and seen the owner's title deed and ID.
A low rent and many other interested people are tricks to rush you. A real landlord can wait a day.
Use a licensed real estate agent and sign a registered tenancy contract before paying anything.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police

opening_line.voice: هلا، أتصل فيك بخصوص الشقة اللي سألت عنها. الإيجار 3,500 درهم في الشهر، بس أنا برا الدولة عشان الشغل وواجد ناس يبونها.
opening_line.whatsapp: هلا، شفت إنك سألت عن شقتي. الإيجار 3,500 درهم في الشهر، بس أنا برا الدولة عشان الشغل وواجد ناس يبونها.
opening_line.email: مشكور على اهتمامك بالشقة. أنا الحين أشتغل برا الدولة، فبحجزها لأول واحد يحوّل عربون 5,000 درهم.
opening_line.sms: هلا، الشقة بعدها موجودة بـ 3,500 درهم في الشهر. في ثلاث غيرك يسألون عنها، فخبرني بسرعة إذا تبيها.

ar.commit_question: جاهز تحوّل العربون اليوم عشان أحجز لك الشقة؟
red_flags: المالك برا الدولة وما يقدر يوريك الشقة
الإيجار أرخص واجد من الشقق اللي مثلها
يطلب عربون قبل لا تشوف الشقة

lesson.headline: لا تدفع أبداً على شقة ما شفتها
three_points: لا تحوّل أي عربون قبل لا تشوف الشقة بنفسك وتشوف سند الملكية وهوية المالك.
الإيجار الرخيص وكثرة الناس اللي يبونها حيلة عشان يستعجلونك. المالك الصدق يقدر يصبر يوم.
تعامل مع وسيط عقاري مرخّص ووقّع عقد إيجار مسجّل قبل لا تدفع أي شي.
lesson.report_to: تواصل مع خدمة أمان في شرطة أبوظبي
